text: On the convergence of a class of nonlinear series. Abstract: sufficient conditions for the convergence of nonlinear series with variable signs are proved; the results generalize the classical d'Alembert's test.
Knot invariants and applications in cryptography. Abstract: a series of new knot invariants is constructed and their application in linking-based cryptographic protocols is shown.
Laborpraktikum zur Quantenoptik. Abstract: Das aktualisierte Laborpraktikum zur Quantenoptik mit zwölf Arbeiten wird beschrieben.
